name: Beno
title: Levite from the family of Merari
summary: Beno was a Levite from the family of Merari, mentioned in David's organization of temple service. He was the son of Jaasia (also known as Jaasja) and belonged to the Levitical lineage that served in the temple. He is only mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Merari
keyEvents.description: Beno is listed as a son of Jaasia in the genealogy of the Levites from the family of Merari, which was organized during King David's time.

keyEvents.title: David's Organization of the Levites
keyEvents.description: As part of David's organization of temple service, Beno's lineage was registered among those who were to serve in the sanctuary.

keyEvents.title: Counting the Descendants of Merari
keyEvents.description: Beno and his descendants were counted among the sons of Merari as part of the Levitical families responsible for service in the Lord's house.

keyEvents.title: The Division of the Levites' Service
keyEvents.description: During David's reign, the Levites, including Beno's family, were divided into groups to ensure orderly service in the sanctuary.
